sheet:
Create an original 40-frame fighting game sprite sheet of DOUGLAS, faithfully based on the LAST TWO ATTACHED reference images: real portrait is identity reference, poster is artistic direction. Adult executive, medium-light warm skin, short neatly slicked black hair, recognizable face with small neat goatee (NOT full beard), natural medium build, not muscular superhero. Outfit identical every frame: charcoal dark suit jacket and trousers, white shirt, silver-gray striped tie, dark formal leather shoes, discreet wristwatch. Detailed high-quality arcade pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, dark clothes with readable blue-gray shading.
TRUE transparent background. Exactly 8 columns x5rows =40 isolated complete full body poses. Target1536x1120,cells192x224. ALL facing RIGHT. Consistent face, body scale and baseline. Generous transparent margins, no overlap, no labels, gridlines, logos, scenery, shadows or effects.
Row1 indices0-7: four subtle idle guarded confident stance variations; four progressive walking steps.
Row2 8-15: walk5,walk6, jump rising knees up, jump apex tucked, jump falling feet down, crouching low, punch startup fist drawn back, punch ACTIVE straight fist fully extended right at shoulder height.
Row3 16-23: punch recovery retracting fist, kick startup knee lifted, kick ACTIVE extending right at LOW WAIST height (shoe halfway between head and ground, NOT head-height kick), kick recovery knee retracting, crouching punch startup guard, crouching punch ACTIVE right fist extended at crouched shoulder height, crouching punch recovery retracting fist, lowkick startup crouched leg bent.
Row4 24-31: lowkick ACTIVE leg extended along ground right, lowkick recovery crouched leg retracting, airborne punch startup knees bent fist back, airborne punch ACTIVE right fist extended slightly DOWN toward opponent, airborne punch recovery retracting, airborne kick startup knee tucked, airborne kick ACTIVE leg extended right below waist, airborne kick recovery tucked.
Row5 32-39: standing high block forearms guard face, crouching block, hurt1 recoil, hurt2 stronger recoil, knockout start losing balance leaning left, knockout fall diagonal head left feet right, knockout lying flat on floor head left feet right, confident victory adjusting tie.
Complete shoes/heads/hands every cell, no touching neighboring poses. Realistic mature facial identity, not anime hero or chibi. Restrained technical fighting posture, not acrobatics.
